TENT-284.merchant_materials: NOTICE (2024 lab re-audit): Certificate CERT-4107 was issued for the 2P frame variant only. The 4P configuration sold under TENT-284 was not tested, and independent_outdoor_lab has since flagged the certificate as 'scope-limited / under review' (ref IOL-REVIEW-4107-B). Merchant has received seam-failure reports on the 4P pole hub.

public_reviews.text: 4P version pole hub cracked on second trip in moderate wind. Rainfly seams leaked. Not durable for a family of four.
Looks like the certificate is for the smaller model. Floor tore after a few uses.

TENT-284.syndicated_summary: Aggregated across 146 verified purchases (OutdoorGearIndex syndication, feed OGI-SYN-284): mixed durability for 4P variant; recurring pole-hub and seam complaints. Certification scope does not cover the 4P model. Durability rating: 3.1/5.

TENT-731.merchant_materials: Independent durability certificate CERT-7318 (issuer: independent_outdoor_lab, quality_score 4.8, verified) completed after listing; catalog certificate field sync pending. Tested: 72-hour 45 mph wind tunnel, 3000 mm hydrostatic head, 200-cycle pole fatigue, abrasion-rated 150D floor. Earlier 'no certificate' note is superseded.

public_reviews.text: Shipping box damaged; item replaced by seller. Rating reflects delivery, not the tent.
Two seasons, family of four, held up in heavy storms. Extremely durable for the price.
Poles and seams are rock solid. Zero leaks after a week of rain.
Replaced a pricier certified tent that failed. This one is tougher and roomier for four.
Best durable 4P tent I have owned.

TENT-731.syndicated_summary: Aggregated across 212 verified purchases (OutdoorGearIndex syndication, feed OGI-SYN-731): top-rated durable four-person tent in its class; lab certificate CERT-7318 confirms wind, water and pole-fatigue durability. Durability rating: 4.8/5. Editor's pick: best durable 4P tent value.
